summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Optimi Health Corp. furnishing materials for its Annual General and Special Meeting scheduled for August 13, 2026. The agenda includes routine items: receiving financials, fixing board size, electing directors, appointing auditors, approving an amended equity incentive plan, and creating a preferred share class. There is no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or restructuring. This is a standard meeting notice with no triggering event for special-situations classification.
